verdict.rationale: OCI's docs mention a Select AI Agent Framework where agent teams can be defined and shared to run tasks, hinting at autonomous background agent execution, but there's no direct evidence of a scheduling/automation service (e.g., OCI Functions, Events, Resource Scheduler) or details on how these agents run unattended in production. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on background job scheduling/triggers, first-party examples of autonomous agent execution, and independent corroboration of these automations working reliably.
